project.description: Builds and deploys the WildFly WAR (pic-sure-api-2.war) + the all-in-one WildFly image. LAYOUT-AWARE: on the monorepo branch (pic_sure_api_rewrite) the WAR is built from the non-aggregated pic-sure-legacy reactor; on flat pre-monorepo main it builds from the repo root. Both on JDK 11. For Phase 2 (gateway owns auth), point git_hash at pic_sure_api_rewrite so the WAR includes GatewayHeaderFilter + the gateway-owns-auth bypass; main works until the cutover but lacks that code.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
if [ -f "/usr/local/docker-config/setProxy.sh" ]; then . /usr/local/docker-config/setProxy.sh fi
GIT_BRANCH_SHORT=`echo ${GIT_BRANCH} | cut -d "/" -f 2` GIT_COMMIT_SHORT=`echo ${GIT_COMMIT} | cut -c1-7`
# Layout-aware: the monorepo branch keeps the WildFly WAR in the non-aggregated # pic-sure-legacy reactor (root reactor is the Java-25 3.0.0 line and must NOT be # built here); flat pre-monorepo main has it at the repo root. Build the right one. if [ -d pic-sure-legacy ]; then LEGACY_DIR=pic-sure-legacy; else LEGACY_DIR=.; fi echo "Building PIC-SURE WildFly WAR from: $LEGACY_DIR"
docker run --rm \ -v "$DOCKER_CONFIG_DIR/jenkins_home/workspace/$JOB_NAME/:/app" \ -v maven_m2_cache:/root/.m2 \ -w /app \ --platform=linux/amd64 \ maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-11 \ sh -lc "cd $LEGACY_DIR && mvn clean install -DskipTests"
mkdir -p /usr/local/docker-config/wildfly/deployments cp "$LEGACY_DIR/pic-sure-api-war/target/pic-sure-api-war.war" /usr/local/docker-config/wildfly/deployments/pic-sure-api-2.war
docker build \ -f "$LEGACY_DIR/docker/all-in-one/all-in-one.Dockerfile" \ --build-arg http_proxy=$http_proxy \ --build-arg https_proxy=$http_proxy \ --build-arg no_proxy="$no_proxy" \ --build-arg HTTP_PROXY=$http_proxy \ --build-arg HTTPS_PROXY=$http_proxy \ --build-arg NO_PROXY="$no_proxy" \ --build-arg PIC_SURE_BUILD_VERSION=LATEST \ -t hms-dbmi/pic-sure-wildfly:${pipeline_build_id} "$LEGACY_DIR"
docker tag hms-dbmi/pic-sure-wildfly:${pipeline_build_id} hms-dbmi/pic-sure-wildfly:LATEST
